caption: The video captures a male lion with a thick dark mane standing on green grass in an outdoor enclosure, viewed from a rear-three-quarter angle with its head oriented left toward a framed mirror. The mirror holds the lion's reflected face, and the reflection tracks the lion's movements throughout. Over time the head and mane gradually descend toward the glass, the reflected face sliding from the upper part of the mirror down toward its lower edge as the bowing motion continues. The hindquarters, rear legs, and torso stay planted in the same position, so the body neither walks nor turns while the neck lowers. The long tail, tipped with a dark tuft, shifts as it hangs, curving and swaying near the grass. Blurred tree trunks and bare earth fill the background, and the white mirror frame stays fixed in place. The lowered posture persists to the end.
